description: This file is a shell script used for stress testing a device using stress-ng. It sets up environment variables, manages test execution, logs system metrics, and runs various stress tests such as CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, and others, with specific configurations based on device properties.

methods.name: log()
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script name to the log file.

methods.name: tearDown()
methods.description: Performs cleanup after tests, stops metrics capture, and removes workspace.

methods.name: logUptime()
methods.description: Logs system uptime to the log file.

methods.name: logMem()
methods.description: Logs system memory details to the log file.

methods.name: execAndRedirectOut()
methods.description: Executes a command, logs start and end, and redirects output to the log file.

methods.name: cpuStressTest()
methods.description: Runs CPU stress tests with different exclusions based on device name.

methods.name: cpuLongRunTest()
methods.description: Runs a long-duration CPU stress test on all online CPUs.

methods.name: diskIOTests()
methods.description: Runs disk I/O stress tests.

methods.name: schedulerTests()
methods.description: Runs scheduler stress tests, excluding certain process types.

methods.name: memStressTest()
methods.description: Runs various memory stress tests.

methods.name: thermalZoneTests()
methods.description: Attempts to run thermal zone temperature stress tests (currently with debug info).

methods.name: pageFaultTests()
methods.description: Runs page fault and related system stress tests.

methods.name: timerTests()
methods.description: Runs timer-related stress tests.

methods.name: networkTests()
methods.description: Runs network stress tests.

methods.name: runAllTests()
methods.description: Runs all stress tests sequentially for a destructive test.

methods.name: memoryPressureTest()
methods.description: Performs memory pressure tests to check application handling of OOM conditions.

methods.name: pipeTests()
methods.description: Runs pipe stress tests.

methods.name: fileTests()
methods.description: Runs filesystem stress tests.

methods.name: ipcTests()
methods.description: Runs inter-process communication stress tests.

methods.name: signalTests()
methods.description: Runs signal handling stress tests.

methods.name: systemcallTests()
methods.description: Runs system call stress tests.

methods.name: getStressExeSize()
methods.description: Logs the size of the stress-ng executable.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes environment, cleans logs, starts metrics capture, and runs initial stress tests.
